import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import spearmanr, kruskal

# 1. Load data
mut_df = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv', usecols=['bcr_patient_barcode'])
expr_df = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Compute TMB (raw mutation count per patient)
tmb = mut_df['bcr_patient_barcode'].value_counts().rename_axis('patient').reset_index(name='tmb')

# 3. Prepare expression matrix: remove version suffix from Ensembl IDs
expr_df.index = expr_df.index.to_series().str.split('.', n=1).str[0]

# 4. Extract PDCD1 expression (Ensembl ID prefix ENSG00000188389)
id_pdcd1 = 'ENSG00000188389'
if id_pdcd1 not in expr_df.index:
    raise KeyError(f"PDCD1 ID {id_pdcd1} not found in expression data")
# Reset index of expression vector
pdcd1_expr = expr_df.loc[id_pdcd1].rename('pdcd1_expr').reset_index()
pdcd1_expr.columns = ['patient', 'pdcd1_expr']

# 5. Merge TMB and PDCD1 expression
df = pd.merge(tmb, pdcd1_expr, on='patient', how='inner')

# 6. Scatter plot and Spearman correlation
rho, pval = spearmanr(df['tmb'], df['pdcd1_expr'])
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))
sns.regplot(x='tmb', y='pdcd1_expr', data=df,
            scatter_kws={'alpha':0.5, 's':20},
            line_kws={'color':'red'})
plt.xlabel('Tumor Mutation Burden (raw count)')
plt.ylabel('PDCD1 expression (log2 FPKM+0.001)')
plt.title(f'Spearman rho={rho:.2f}, p={pval:.3g}')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
print(f"Spearman correlation: rho = {rho:.3f}, p-value = {pval:.3g}")

# 7. TMB tertiles and Kruskal-Wallis test
df['tmb_tertile'] = pd.qcut(df['tmb'], q=3, labels=['Low','Medium','High'])
groups = [group['pdcd1_expr'].values for _, group in df.groupby('tmb_tertile')]
H, kw_p = kruskal(*groups)

plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))
sns.boxplot(x='tmb_tertile', y='pdcd1_expr', data=df, order=['Low','Medium','High'])
plt.xlabel('TMB tertile')
plt.ylabel('PDCD1 expression')
plt.title(f'PDCD1 by TMB tertile (KW p={kw_p:.3g})')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
print("TMB tertile counts:")
print(df['tmb_tertile'].value_counts().sort_index())
print(f"Kruskal-Wallis H = {H:.3f}, p-value = {kw_p:.3g}")
